items.name: Facebook post (organic page / group post)
items.one_line: Organic post on a Facebook page or in a group that starts conversation or shares an update, written for comments and shares.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr's social media copywriting Platform facet shows Facebook as the second-largest platform on 2026-10-04 (1663 gigs).

sources.title: Fiverr: Social Media Copywriting category (Platform facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Platform filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal: Instagram 1910, Facebook 1663, LinkedIn 1338, TikTok 1009, Pinterest 376, Threads 238, Snapchat 123, Reddit 96, Twitter 47, Discord 5, Quora 3

items.note: Paid Facebook ads are genre_commercial. In India Facebook groups remain strong for local, regional-language and older audiences.

items.name: Faceless / AI-generated video script
items.one_line: VO-led script for a channel with no on-camera host, where every line also specifies the generated or stock visual that carries it.
items.value_evidence: Upwork's script writer job type lists 'Scripts for AI-generated or animated videos' as a common project (Upwork, 2026-01-21).

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: YouTube's inauthentic/repetitious content policy targets mass-produced templated videos; the script must add original narrative or analysis.

items.name: Fact-check article
items.one_line: Article that tests one specific public claim against evidence, shows the method and sources, and ends on a clear rating.
items.value_evidence: Produced by dedicated fact-checking desks held to the IFCN Code of Principles; no freelance marketplace category found on 2026-10-04.

sources.title: IFCN Code of Principles: the commitments
sources.supports: Five commitments for signatory fact-checkers: non-partisanship and fairness, transparency of sources, of funding and organisation, of methodology, and an open corrections policy

items.note: Follow the IFCN commitments (same standard for every claim, replicable sources, published method, open corrections). Quote the claim exactly, link the original, show each verification step; a rating scale must be defined. In India, election-season fact-checks interact with comp:eci_mcc.

items.name: FAQ / answer article for AI search
items.one_line: Page built from real customer questions, each answered directly in the first one or two sentences, so search engines and AI answers can lift and cite it.
items.value_evidence: Driven by AI search interest in 2026; Google itself says no special optimization or markup is needed for AI Overviews / AI Mode beyond normal SEO best practice (last updated 2025-12-10).

sources.title: Google Search Central: AI features and your website (last updated 2025-12-10)
sources.supports: Google says there are no additional requirements or special optimizations to appear in AI Overviews or AI Mode; the same SEO fundamentals apply and no special AI text files or markup are needed

items.note: Write for the question, not for 'AI'; vendors selling special AI files or markup contradict Google's own page. Pairs with trend:geo_ai_search.

items.name: FAQ page
items.one_line: Questions and answers that remove purchase objections and cut support load.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr Website Content lists 'FAQs'; India rate tables have a separate FAQ-content row; AWAI lists FAQs

sources.title: Fiverr: Website Content subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 4310 gigs; page-type filter = Landing page, Bio/About us, Homepage, Product page, Sales page, Generic content, FAQs, Contact us, Blog post, Privacy policy, Service page, Reviews, Testimonials, Terms & conditions, Press release

sources.supports: India per-word rate tables by industry with separate rows for web pages, FAQ content, brochures and marketing material

sources.supports: copywriting pricing guide naming each project type with its own fee guideline; project names checked in the page HTML 2026-10-04

items.note: Each answer should stand alone (people and AI answer engines read one at a time).

items.name: Feature article
items.one_line: In-depth, story-led article that uses scenes, anecdotes and quotes to explore a person, trend or issue beyond the bare news facts.
items.value_evidence: Journalism curricula teach features as a distinct story type with delayed/anecdotal leads (NVCC Introduction to Journalism I); Fiverr's 'Long-form article' type is the largest article facet (3494 gigs on 2026-10-04), though not all of it is journalism.

sources.title: Jasmine Roberts, Introduction to Journalism I (NVCC Pressbooks, CC BY-NC 4.0, 2023): Types of news stories
sources.supports: Defines straight/hard news (inverted pyramid, essential facts, impartial), features (in-depth, storytelling devices, soft news; profiles are an example) and the editorial (argument representing an editorial board's official view)

sources.title: Introduction to Journalism I (NVCC Pressbooks): table of contents incl. Headlines, Feature leads, Types of Features, Crafting the Nut
sources.supports: Journalism course syllabus that treats headlines, summary leads, feature leads, nut graphs and feature types as separately taught skills; features use delayed or anecdotal leads and more direct quotes than news

sources.title: Fiverr: Articles & Blog Posts category (Article type facet read 2026-10-04)
sources.supports: Fiverr's Article type filter with live gig counts, a SUPPLY signal (how many sellers offer it): Long-form article 3494, Informational 3483, Instructional/How-to 3138, News story 1738, Research article 1713, First-person narrative 1507, Listicle 1243, Review 679, Affiliate marketing 323, Opinion piece 280, Technical article 254

items.note: Needs a nut graph (why this story, why now) within the first few paragraphs. Brand journalism / company-blog features use the same shape.

items.name: Festival greeting copy
items.one_line: Short greeting text for Diwali, Holi, Eid, Christmas, Navratri, Chhath and other festivals, for people, leaders and organisations.
items.value_evidence: Every brand, party and leader posts festival greetings; agencies and political content teams write them on a calendar.
items.note: Use the festival's correct name and greeting in the right language and script (e.g., Chhath, Onam, Pongal). Respect the meaning of the day; leaders' greetings follow a formal register. Brand greeting ads belong to the commercial worker.

items.name: Film treatment / step outline
items.one_line: A prose telling of a film or series in present tense, scene by scene or act by act, used to sell or plan before the screenplay.
items.value_evidence: A pitching and development document inside screenwriting deals; SWA registers story, plot and synopsis documents of this kind.

sources.title: Screenwriters Association (India): Script registration guidelines
sources.supports: SWA registers Synopsis, Story, Script, Plot, Screenplay, Dialogue and Song for members, online or at its Mumbai office

items.note: Present tense, vivid but brief, follows the story beats in order including the ending. Indian producers often ask for a one-page story, then a step outline, then the screenplay.

items.name: Flash fiction / microfiction
items.one_line: A complete story in a very small word budget, often ending on a twist or an image.
items.value_evidence: Contest and literary-magazine market; little paid demand.
items.note: Word caps are set per market or contest. Hindi 'laghukatha' is an established short-short form.

items.name: Nonprofit fundraising appeal
items.one_line: Donation ask by email, letter or page that moves a supporter to give now.
items.value_evidence: Fiverr Email Copy lists 'Fundraising Emails'; Upwork has a Grant Writers hire category for the institutional side

sources.title: Fiverr: Email Copy subcategory
sources.supports: page search data on 2026-10-04: num_found 1782 gigs; email-type filter = Welcome emails, Lead generation/Cold emailing, Newsletters, Email Sequences, Special offers, New product announcement, Follow-Up Emails, Transactional emails, Curated content, Internal updates, Fundraising Emails

sources.supports: dedicated hire category (page refuses fetchers; title/description seen in search results 2026-10-04, snippet-only)

items.note: India: 80G tax-exemption wording and FCRA limits on foreign donations affect the ask. Grant proposals may belong to genre_pro_creative.

items.name: Game narrative / dialogue / interactive fiction
items.one_line: Branching story, character dialogue and in-world text for video games and interactive fiction.
items.value_evidence: Game studios hire narrative designers and game writers as distinct roles.
items.note: Delivered in spreadsheets or tools (Twine, Ink, Yarn) with node IDs, conditions and barks; any line may be read out of order. Respect UI string length limits.

items.name: Ghostwritten book / memoir
items.one_line: A full book written in the client's voice and published under their name.
items.value_evidence: Upwork lists ghostwriting as a freelance writing type with a stated hourly band; Fiverr runs a Ghostwriting subcategory under book writing.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: ghostwriters write books, speeches and thought leadership without byline; rate band $20-$45 per hour

sources.title: Fiverr Writing & Translation: Book & eBook Writing: Ghostwriting
sources.supports: category exists on the Writing & Translation menu

items.note: Interview-driven: record, transcribe, outline, draft chapter by chapter, client approves each. Contract must state confidentiality, credit and rights.

items.name: Ghostwritten founder / executive social posts
items.one_line: Retainer service that captures a founder's voice through interviews and turns it into regular posts published under their own name.
items.value_evidence: Agencies publish monthly retainer pricing for founder LinkedIn ghostwriting (Foundera's 2026 comparison titles its range '$1.5K-$15K/mo'; third-party, low confidence); Upwork lists social posts and thought leadership among ghostwriting projects.

sources.title: Foundera: LinkedIn Ghostwriting Pricing 2026: $1.5K-$15K/mo Compared
sources.supports: Agency-published pricing comparison for founder LinkedIn ghostwriting retainers (third-party, low confidence; the range is in the page's own title)

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: The deliverable is the system (voice interview, idea bank, approval loop) plus the posts; see genre:linkedin_post and genre:x_post for the post shapes. Never invent the founder's experiences.

items.name: Glossary / definition page
items.one_line: Short page that defines one term clearly in the first lines, then adds context, examples and links to deeper content.
items.value_evidence: Usually produced in bulk inside programmatic or content-strategy projects; agency playbooks rate glossary pages below bottom-of-funnel pages for pipeline (Optiseon, low confidence).

sources.title: Optiseon: B2B SaaS SEO in 2026: the playbook that drives pipeline
sources.supports: Agency playbook naming comparison, alternatives, integration and use-case pages as the bottom-of-funnel page types B2B SaaS teams prioritise in 2026 (third-party, low confidence)

items.note: Exposed to AI-answer substitution; the definition must still be the first sentence.

items.name: Government press note / press release
items.one_line: An official release from a ministry or department announcing a decision, scheme, event or rebuttal.
items.value_evidence: PIB publishes releases for every central ministry daily; state information departments do the same.

sources.title: Press Information Bureau (PIB)
sources.supports: central government's channel publishing ministry press releases in English, Hindi and regional languages

items.note: Official register: dateline, ministry, headline, lead paragraph with the decision, details, quotes from the minister, background. Bilingual (English and Hindi) is the norm. Corporate press releases belong to the commercial worker.

items.name: Grant proposal
items.one_line: A funding application that shows a funder a fundable problem, a credible plan, a budget and measurable outcomes.
items.value_evidence: Grant writing is an established paid specialism (funders and portals publish how-to-apply guidance; Indian CSR and research funders each run proposal calls); market-category page could not be fetched (403), so tier rests on that.

sources.title: Grants.gov: Grant Writing Basics
sources.supports: US federal grants portal's official guidance on writing grant applications (page is script-rendered; existence checked 2026-10-04, text not read)

items.note: Follow the funder's template and word limits exactly; scoring rubrics decide. India: CSR funds under Companies Act Schedule VII and government research schemes (ANRF/DST) each set their own format.

items.name: Greeting / wishes message (birthday, anniversary, congratulations)
items.one_line: A short personal message for a milestone, written to feel personal rather than copied.
items.value_evidence: Huge consumer search demand but almost no paid market; template sites dominate.
items.note: One specific detail about the person beats any generic line. Festival greetings are a separate genre (genre:festival_greeting).

items.name: Guest post (article for another site)
items.one_line: Article written for publication on someone else's blog or site, to reach its audience and earn a byline and a link back.
items.value_evidence: Sold as a link-building service by SEO vendors and bundled into article writing (Upwork content-writing types, 2026-01-21); the Fiverr guest-posting category page was blocked by a bot check on 2026-10-04, so its size is unverified.

sources.title: Upwork: 14 Types of Freelance Writing Jobs and What They Pay (published 2026-01-21)
sources.supports: Upwork's own list of freelance writing job types with typical hourly rate bands charged on Upwork (blog/web content $15-$35/hr, content writer $15-$40/hr, ghostwriter $20-$45/hr, script writer $30-$56/hr, email & newsletter $15-$40/hr; newswriters $34-$62/hr citing Glassdoor) and project lists per type

items.note: Write to the host site's guidelines and audience. Guest posts placed mainly to pass keyword-rich links are treated as link spam under Google's spam policies; disclose any payment.

items.name: Headline + dek (title and standfirst)
items.one_line: The headline and the one- or two-line summary under it (dek / standfirst) that sell a story on a homepage, feed or search result.
items.value_evidence: Headline writing is taught as its own module in journalism courses (NVCC Introduction to Journalism I, chapter 'Headlines'); every commissioned article needs one.

sources.title: Introduction to Journalism I (NVCC Pressbooks): table of contents incl. Headlines, Feature leads, Types of Features, Crafting the Nut
sources.supports: Journalism course syllabus that treats headlines, summary leads, feature leads, nut graphs and feature types as separately taught skills; features use delayed or anecdotal leads and more direct quotes than news

items.note: Headline FORMULAS live in the hook kind (hook:*); this card is the deliverable. Web headlines usually need both a display headline and an SEO title.
